nom: FARMACY Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: This moisturizer is the best on the market. Light yet nourishing. It completely changes the texture of my skin. There is nothing else I will use. I recommend this product to everyone. The price is well worth the it. Love it so much

This cream is really good which is unfortunate for my wallet as its almost $50. I was using a drugstore moisturizer for a long time but noticed an increase of texture on my forehead, something I havent seen since high school. I decided to pick up the mini version of this cream to test it out and my skin was noticeably better after one use. I highly recommend this cream to anyone. It has a slight honey smell so if you are sensitive to scents I'd recommend trying the mini first to see if you like it. For me the scent is very pleasant. I will be buying the full size.
Helped pull together skin molecules, less scaring on my cheeks too !

avis.titre: I'm on my second jar and I'm still in love!
avis.texte: I'm notorious for always looking for the next best thing to try in skincare, but I keep coming back to this moisturizer. It is so incredibly soothing that no matter how irritated my sensitive skin might be, it always feels great to apply and seems to calm it right now. Smells amazing too. This isn't necessarily an anti-aging moisturizer, because it doesn't contain actives like retinol or vitamin C. But I'm in my mid 40s and can attest that there is a plumping effect from this moisturizer that does make my skin look younger and glowy.

I will be absolutely devastated if they ever stop making this or change the formula. My FAVORITE facial lotion ever. Literally transformed my skin in just a couple days of use. I have oily skin so a little goes a long way with this. It's 100% worth the price, and I cannot recommend it enough. My only gripe is the packaging - it's thick and heavy, which seems unnecessary.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again!
avis.texte: One of the best moisturizers I have ever used. Highly recommend.
After 2 hours this cream had my forehead red, itchy with welts. I was told it was an allergic reaction from the propolis, and royal jelly.
I love this moisturizer, it is gentle and hydrating. My combination skin loves it. It does not feel greasy or heavy. A little definitely goes a long way.
I will purchase this again, I was having dry feeling on my face and this has fixed it. I don't wake up feeling dryness underneath my eyes.

I received a sample of Honey Halo in an Ulta package. I used it on my eczema flare up spots morning and night, and I saw dramatic results in a few days. Ceramides are key! I am ordering more Honey Halo to add to my eczema treatment products!
I genuinely feel like my face becomes visibly plumper and more hydrated as soon as I put this moisturizer on. Love it!
I have eczema and my skin is soooo sensitive. This works great with skin and is super hydrating
Perfectly hydrating, but not greasy or heavy. Makes my skin feel spectacular!

I needed a really moisturizing lotion for my face, and the FARMACY Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer was perfect! It's rich, hydrating, and leaves my skin feeling soft and nourished all day without being greasy. A must-have for anyone with dry or thirsty skin!

HOLY MOLY THIS PRODUCT IS SERIOUSLY AS GOOD AS THE REVIEWS MAKE IT SEEM! I was NOT a believer, really skeptical that a moisturizer could be that good.. but it is! My overall texture, tone, clarity, moisture/bounciness, and overall skin appearance have improved tremendously in just a month using this in the PM. Don't worry, this product is SAFE FOR MY ACNE PRONE GIRLIES! Buy this moisturizer, you won't regret it. If ya can, pair it with Farmacy's Honey Milk Essence- it's game changing.

avis.titre: Perfect moisturizer for my sensitive combination skin.
avis.texte: Most lotions would either burn, be too oily, or not absorb at all. I had none of these problems with this moisturizer which is a first. My skin barrier was in shambles and I feel like this product has been repairing it.

The only con is the price. Besides that, i'm in love. Rich but not greasy, literally buttery but not heavy…it's so smooth and soothing, it's crazy. I have dry sensitive skin and eczema and this is my new favorite facial moisturizer.

I love the scent of this moisurizer and love how hydrating it is yet is not greasy. I have sensitive combination skin and feel like this works really well on it as it is hydrating but not oily. This is expensive but worth it especially if there's a coupon or free gift with purchase.

avis.titre: Overall A+ but INCREDIBLE for Dark Eye Circles
avis.texte: I received a sample of this, and it's wonderful! I've done DIY honey masks for years, as someone with combo skin since honey has the special quality of being bith intensely hydrating but also antibacterial. The BEST aspect is how it reduces my undereye dark circles, though! I was shocked! The best alternative I've found for this issue is a DIY mask of honey + ghee. Ghee is fabulous for brightening, but it clogs pores elsewhere, and if it gets in your eye it's awful. This provides the same benefits without the cons of the DIY mask! Also great for non-oily hydration and fine lines.
Love this cream. It moisturizes very well and leaves my skin silky smooth.
I have spent so long looking for a perfect moisturizer and this is it. Orderinfg my third one now and highlyyyyy recommend. Just do it
I've been using this moisturizer in the morning and night, and I absolutely love it. I have dry, sensitive skin, and this is perfect for both. The smell is amazing as well.

This is the 1 product that's truly improved my skin &I've tried a lot! Despite my diet &water intake being worse lately &cutting out all other skincare, my skin looks more vibrant &plump. Not sure if my milia will get worse tho,TBD. 30s combo skin

This is a good moisturizer to use for days out in the sun, beach, pool, etc. I bought it for extra hydration as my skin has been extra dry lately but I feel like I have also broke out more on days I use this. Maybe its just me as the reviews tend to be good for most people but perhaps not sensitive/oily skin prone people.

I love the way this moisturizer makes me skin look and feel! From the way it smells, to the way it makes such a difference in my skin. I read reviews that people didn't like the jar, I love the jar! It's like a honeycomb, makes it easy to open, because you can grab onto it and it doesn't move, just the lid, and love the magnetic spatula! GOODBYE TATCHA!

I really wanted to love this moisturizer. It smells great and has a lovely texture, and I'm a sucker for anything with honey in it. But every time I use it, I get pimples and visibly clogged pores the next day. I'll use it once, stop for a few weeks, then try again, and the same thing happens every time. I can't figure out what ingredient(s) is causing the problem, as none of them stand out as typical pore-cloggers. So disappointed. Beware if you are at all acne-prone.

Works well under makeup and melts into the skin. I purchased a sample kit with this moisturizer and just bought the full size as I never want to run out. After two weeks, skin looks plumper and texture has improved.
This is for the review readers like myself who cant try something new without reading reviews first. Try it. This calms and soothes my skin like nothing ive ever experienced.

I've been looking for so long for my perfect moisturizer. this is it for me. Soaks in beautifully for me. does not break me out, which has been a common problem with moisturizers for me, especially if my skin thinks i used too much. I just love this stuff, it just works for me. I have never looked forward to my moisturizer but I do with this. I bought about 6 months ago and held off to see if my ardor would fade. it has not. worth the money for my now on the dry side perimenopausal skin.❤️

I think that there are a lot of high quality skincare products at more affordable price points. That said, this moisturizer is worth every penny! I typically have dry skin that gets more oily during my cycle, and it works SO well no matter what state my skin is in. It's creamy and dewy without being too heavy. It gives all day hydration, and it even wears well under makeup. I've also had less acne flares since incorporating this product into my routine. I cant say enough great things about how amazing this product is and how much I love it!
I have this and I absolutely love it!!! It's so refreshing on my skin!!! I smells great too! I have super sensitive skin and this product helps so much!
This is my holy grail moisturizer. It is the only thing that does not break out my sensitive skin. I always stock up on this.
This was the worst product I've ever used! I had to stop because it gave me perioral dermatitis around my mouth and I've never had it before until I started using this product. Buyer be warned!

The new version of their honey moisturizer is leagues better than the original. The original was so sticky and difficult to apply whereas this one is an actual lotion that applies easily and smoothly. The scent is lightly of honey, and the application feels a bit sticky to the touch afterwards, but not in a bad way. My skin definitely feels hydrated after applying it, and a little goes a long way. I do feel it is on the richer side though, so I'm not able to use this daily with my oily skin type.

I really wanted to love this product but my skin unfortuantely had a reaction. The first week it was great! Super mousturizing and didn't make me look greasy at all. But unfortuantely my skin type didn't react well over time. I have extremely sensitive skin and I also have PCOS so when I went through the first week I started getting a rash just along my smile lines to my nose. I thought maybe it'd clear up the more I got used to it but it got worse. It eventually turned into acne and super dry and patchy where it reacted. Once I stopped using it and went back to my old mousturizer it cleared up. I know it works for a lot of people but for those that might have super sensitive skin or PCOS, keep in mind it might create a reaction. Otherwise in the areas that didn't get affected it is super moistizing and smells great. I wish my skin type didn't react so badly, otherwise I'd say it's a great product.

I rarely write reviews for anything, but this moisturizer has calmed my skin immensely. I bought this as an attempt to find something cheaper than Tatcha, which I've used for years now. Imagine my surprise when this was not only cheaper but BETTER. My redness was immediately reduced after beginning, and after continued use its only improved. My skin looks so good, I won't be going back to Tatcha!

Absolutely luxurious makes my skin feel amazing! I have VERY sensitive skin and am acne prone and this moisturizer is SO non irritating, smells wonderful and is healing my barrier. The only con is the expense of it but a little goes a long way!
never had a moisturizer give me literal glowy skin. If you're skin looks dull, this will transform it INSTANTLY! and you'll glow all day! No greasy feeling after use love that.
never had a moisturizer give me literal glowy skin. If you're skin looks dull, this will transform it INSTANTLY! and you'll glow all day! No greasy feeling after use love that.

avis.titre: My skin runs on honey halo
avis.texte: No notes. Except I need it in a tube for on the go and a body lotion version. Perfect consistency, smells great, soothing. . . I'll never stop buying. AND doesn't pill with retinol.
Love this moisturizer - very soothing and gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: At 41 yrs old I finally love my skin
avis.texte: After I turned 40 the line I have been using for 10 yrs stopped working. I developed dry welts on the apple of my cheeks, with my entire face burning & itching. After trying a homemade honey mask my skin slightly improved, so I started researching & that's how I found Farmacy. Within maybe 2 weeks my dry spots were gone & I had them for 3 months! I bought the trial sizes of the entire line & I think I found my product soulmate. My wrinkles are reduced & my skin is glowing. My skin is almost flawless. As somebody who suffered with acne since 3rd grade I have always had a reason to hate looking in the mirror but this is the 1st time in my life I can look & not hate myself. I'm sure it sounds dumb but I cried out of happiness tonight & order bigger sizes of the line. The fact that they even sell trial sizes makes me feel as though this is 1 of the few companies that respect their clients wallets & know they developed amazing product. Thank you guys, you all have developed miracles in all your bottles

I love the feel of the moisturizer! The moisturizer is lightweight, smooth and hydrating. The smell isn't overpowering, very subtle. I've 3 different sizes of this moisturizer, it's that good! My skin is super sensitive, so anything I put on my face has to be good.
I've purchased this several times and am always pleased with the quality. I just wish it was a little more moisturizing on my aging skin.
It smells amazing, and feels instantly hydrating on the skin. My favorite moisturizer, i just wish it wasnt so expensive. A bottle lasts me a little over 2 months

avis.titre: I'm looking forward to using this again in the morning!
avis.texte: I've never actively pursued a product to write a positive review, but here I am! Recommended by an Ulta employee today and I'm using this lotion for the first time tonight. I've never felt my skin drink up a moisturizer…until just now. I put extra on twice because it just felt so immensely hydrating and great on my skin. I swear my wrinkles just plumped out. I'm looking forward to using this again in the morning!

I have tried a few affordable moisturizers lately and this one I keep coming back too!! A little goes a lont way! Ir smells lightly of honey and moisturizers very well. Makeup looks great also after using.

As an Ulta Employee this my favourite moisturizer ever and I am always recommending it to customers who are looking for a good hydrating, thick, and long lasting moisturizer. I put it on in the morning and at night and it is perfect for priming makeup. I feel like even after a full day I still feel hydrated. I will say the smell is very earthy and might not be for everyone but as I use it the smell doesnt bother me anymore. The magentic spatula is also a great feature and makes it very convenient to scoop out as much product as possible. But I recommend cleaning it often; not hard to clean though. Overall 10/10 product!!

I've tried over 10 moisturizers, and this is the only one my sensitive, retinol-using, acne-prone skin actually loves. The honey seems to be evening out my skin tone, and since switching to this, I haven't had any flaking or burning from retinol. If you're on the fence or worried it's too expensive - trust me, it's not. I've actually cut down on the number of products I use because this moisturizer does so much. I love it!! Trying their SPF next!

avis.titre: great for Oily skin or acne prone
avis.texte: my face was sensitive due to using Tretional on my face and even my own routine I was using; I couldn't use anymore, because it was causing a burning sensation so I went into Ulta and this was the only one that didn't do that. It instantly soothe my skin and i felt that it heal it up faster. I heard great things about honey and its properties, I also have acne as well and i dont notice it breaking me out , more calming effect of anything

Love this moisturizer. Used under makeup and paired flawlessly. Have used at night and really sinks in skin. No break outs and i have combo skin. Ive tried moisturizers from Chanel to Vanicream and this one just does it.
Very hydrating moisturizer with a light honey scent. Applies easily onto my skin and doesn't irritate it. My skin feels soft and supple. Love it.

I usually have very clear skin, but its very dry. I bought this product hoping to combat how dry my skin was and it completely broke me out. I have a cluster of small red pimples taking up almost my entire forehead and my nose. Its horrible. Be very cautious!

This is one of the best moisturizers I have ever used. It is basically the only one I use in the winter and the drier, colder months. It is so soothing and calming on my skin and actually doesn't burn when I put it on, even after actives! It also smells amazing Please never change the formula or discontinue this product. It is one of the best!!
Leaves my skin soft. Is not oily or greasy and helps with my dry skin.
I dislike this so much. Please bring back Honey Dew. Leaves a strange filmy feeling and it is too thick. Leaves face looking very matte/dull.

How did I just now find out about this product?? I've struggled with extremely dry skin for years and used the usual dermatologist-recommended creams for dry skin, but nothing was working. I still had flaky skin, especially when I put makeup on. I got a sample of Honey Halo from Ulta and was immediately impressed with it. It hydrates my skin like no other product! It also smells amazing (natural, not perfumy). After a week of using the sample, I bought a full size. I'm so happy I found this! My skin is glowing now and I haven't had any flakes since I started using the sample.
The best moisturizer I've ever tried. It's not oily or watery, doesn't cause breakouts, it smells good but natural and not overpowering, it keeps my skin moisturized! I love it so much.
This is the best moisturizer ever. I love this stuff. It's like butter, so luxurious. I love all farmacy products. Customer forever.
Leaves my skin feeling amazing all day definitely buying the bigger size but a little goes along way. I LOVE IT!!

I tried this product about 5 years ago and I have been using it ever since. It healed my skin the absolute best face cream so worth the money and it lasts such a long time. I never write reviews and I rarely ever rebuy things but this brand specially and this product I have bought so many times already. It's so moisturizing but if you have oily skin this will still work wonders for you.
It's ok but nothing compares to honey drop, so sad please bring it back
Love the honey smell of this moisturizer, it definitely has made my skin feel better, in terms of the stability, I saw improved redness and less breakouts.

The overwhelmingly positive reviews here made me think this would be the cushiest, dreamiest cream. Instead it's just a step above a gel cream with unnecessary fragrance imho. I have dry skin that's not particularly sensitive and this immediately burned my cheeks. I had to wash it off which was fine because the fragrance was awful anyway. I think this would be good for someone with normal or combo skin that likes a strong fragrance on their face.
I found my new everyday cream. Hydration is amazing, makes my skin smooth and buttery. Feels long term moisturized and goes well under makeup. Its like butter! A must buy!
Absolute the best moisturizer. This helps my dry patches more than anything else. Love learning about this from YouTuber Jaime French

I have sensitive, easily congested skin and have not had luck with heavier moisturizers. I have tried plenty of creams, and have gotten pretty good at predicting whether or not a product will break me out on first contact. I kept hearing about this Honey Halo moisturizer and didn't want to commit to the full size until I felt the product and observed my skin's reaction to it. Something told me trying the mini size of this relatively pricey moisturizer would be a mistake, because I might end up falling in love and be forced to buy the larger size forever. I was right. I ended up getting the 1.7 oz jar less than 24 hrs after getting the 0.5 oz mini. This moisturizer glides on much easier than expected. It feels creamy, not greasy, and a little goes a long way. Some thicker creams leave me feeling gross and in need of another wash, but this one sinks in and softens without stickiness. I haven't experienced any of the itching or clogged pores that other rich moisturizers have caused. I don't really like the smell, but it's pretty mild. I plan to use this at night mostly, but it's suitable for daytime use as well.
This is my 3rd bottle. I like the texture and how it moisturized my face. This would be better without rapeseed oil and "aroma" in it. It slightly irritates my sensitive skin.
Really loving this moisturizer. Thick enough. And the magnetic scoop. Only wish came in larger size.

avis.titre: Last face cream I'll ever buy!
avis.texte: I waited to review, my 50yo skin is fickle and I have allergies. This made my skin smooth and appear more even and no blotchy marks! I'm loving my skin again!

avis.titre: The most amazing moisturizer for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I don't ever write reviews but this product has changed my life. I've been using this moisturizer for 6 months now along with farmacys honey milk and my skin is the happiest it has ever been. I struggled with perioral dermatitis for about a year and these two products have significantly helped with that condition. I have extremely sensitive skin and I have no reactions. The product also wears very well under makeup. Highly recommend!

This is what my skin dreams of after a cold dry winter. It feels thick and luxurious, but a little goes a long way! I have to use less than i do with other moisturizers otherwise i have to spread it down the neck and chest to use it up. This will be a permanent staple in my beauty routine!

My skin was dull and dry before I started using this product! It melts into your skin like butter and a little goes a long way! I am in love! Probably not the best for oily skin in the AM. I have combination skin and I use it AM and PM.
Light weight and hydrates the skin nicely ! A bit pricey in my opinion but i love its really healthy 100/100 in yuka no harmful ingredients

avis.titre: Honey halo ultra hydrating ceramide moisturizer
avis.texte: I absolutely in love with this product and no irration on my skin at all

The moisturizer is definitely the best thing I've had on my face in quite a while. I have noticed a dramatic difference. I adore the container also and the little spatula comes with. I bought one at Christmas. I just started my second jar. In the company's lip balm is very good.
My favorite moisturizer. Hydrating, and a little goes a long way!
I used to love this moisturizer. It was very hydrating and didnt break me out. But when i repurchased it recently it broke me out, gave me a rash, and made my face itch and i dont have sensitive skin

I have such dry skin right now cause of the weather. Im super sensitive and this is my favorite moisturizer ever. Ive tried tulu, drunk elephant, clique, vanicream, dermalogical, you name it 🤣 this beats them all

I have such dry skin right now cause of the weather. Im super sensitive and this is my favorite moisturizer ever. Ive tried tulu, drunk elephant, clique, vanicream, dermalogical, you name it 🤣 this beats them all
This is amazing for my dry acne prone skin, it soften, and smooth. I cant get enough of it and need a bigger size at ulta!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: My skin gets very dry in the winter. This did an excellent job of making my skin moist and radiant again.
I really like this. Only a little bit is needed. The smell is OK. I also really like the scoop is magnetic and attaches to the top.
I really like this product. And it seems a little bit is all that's needed. Smell is OK.

This is the best face moisturizer I've ever used in my life. It is so superior to anything else. It's thick but not too heavy and just feels so good on the skin. It melts into the skin so luxuriously in a way I've never experienced from a face cream. I'm also picky about moisturizers because I have incredibly dry skin, especially in the winter. It's perfect. In the past I would use a moisturizer and still wake up with dry skin or after washing my face with something strong like benzoyl peroxide. I can trust this moisturizer to keep me hydrated after using something like retinol too. I haven't woken up with dry skin since I started using it despite it being February in PA. I look forward to using this before bed because it's such a treat. A little goes a long way! The scent is so nice too. Not overpowering at all. I also think it's 100% worth the money and I don't often feel that way about products. If you're on the fence, just do it. You will not regret it! Treat yourself. You deserve it.
This product is unbelievable. Havw been searching for a solid moisturizer especially with this dry winter air - this did not disappoint!! Buy buy buy
I feel like my skin is grainy after application. I'm 64 and need quality moisture products for my face. I may return it if I feel like I need more moisture.
I would still buy this but if you're acne prone and dont have a whole skin care routine then this product could be too thick for you

This is the BEST thing to ever happen to my skin! I was struggling with eczema, dryness, sensitivity and acne. Every moisturizer I tried broke me out worse, or burned after applying. I recieved a free sample of this moisturizer and after trying it twice, I immediately purchased the full size! My skin is smooth and my acne is actually starting to clear up?! I can't believe it. This one is worth the price!
Melts right into the skin and is honestly the best for priming my makeup! The smell and texture are heavenly. I will continue to buy forever!
I use to use this brand alot. I was excited to try this face cream, but it didn't work out for me at all. I ended up breaking out from using it and I don't even have sensitive skin.

This moisturizer is very hydrating and has a great consistency. Me and my boyfriend have dry skin and this moisturizer leaves our skin feeling hydrated and smooth! I've tried many moisturizers in my life and this is one of the best.

I use this moisturizer in the morning and it makes my skin so glowy! Ive had people telling me i look like im wearing makeup when i'm not because my skin looks like glass! It also smells great and doesn't irritate my skin.

avis.titre: Skin looks and feels hydrated and healthy!!!
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin so trying skincare products is often a game of trial and error that usually ends in error. But i took a chance with this product and im so glad i did. Within two weeks of using this in place of my old moisturizer (and keeping everything else in my routine the same) i started to notice a difference in my skin. It looks hydrated, plump, and glowey! I was not expecting such immediate results or to fall in love with this product like i have. It's a rich consistency but doesnt feel too heavy or greasy. Definitely my new go to moisturizer!
Been using Farmacy for years now. When my skin needs comfort and hydration i go to honey halo. Great for cold weather.

2024 was the year my skin barrier got wrecked…my skin was so dehydrated and begging for a routine with a great moisturizing ceramide cream. Fast forward to January 2025 where I found my local Ulta store started carrying Farmacy products! This moisturizer is very rich, but perfect for the dry girlies looking to plump up their dehydrated skin! Scent is fairly mild, but I love the smell of honey. I paired it with the milky essence and hyaluronic acid from the same line, and my skin feels so smooth. I don't think I'll use this in the a.m. under makeup, as I think it would be too rich. But it will definitely be a p.m. staple! I was not gifted this by Farmacy, this is an honest individual review!

This is my new favorite winter moisturizer. I can't express how amazing my skin feels after having been using this. It is super hydrating, really thick and luscious. A little goes a long way. My skin feels plumper and I no longer feel tightness from by skin being on the drier side. Complimentary from farmacybeauty

This moisturizer is amazing! It's very hydrating and it leaves my skin plump with a gorgeous glow. A little goes a long way with this moisturizer. This moisturizer is perfect for the winter months . I highly recommend getting this moisturizer! Gifted by farmacybeauty

This Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Moisturizer is IT! The ceramides are doing their thing because my skin stays so hydrated, like all day. My face has this crazy healthy glow—like, I legit look like I've been drinking a gallon of water daily (which I haven't, lol). If you want skin that glows and looks fresh, this is the one. Obsessed! Gifted by Farmacy

This stuff is so amazing. I have very bad eczema in the winter and honey is supposed to help that so this product is amazing if you have dry skin or eczema, prone skin highly recommend to anyone gifted by

avis.titre: Dry skin girlies this is THE product
avis.texte: I rarely write reviews unless something is absoulutely horrendous or astronomically blissful. This is the later. Its thick but not like Nivea or Vaseline. Smells like honey. Lasts for months. A little goes a long way. Worth the price.

I am obsessed with this cream. I love the thick creamy texture and the way it glides on the skin. It is super hydrating and moisturizing and the slightly sweet honey smell is lovely. It's one of my faves! Gifted by farmacy beauty.

I was gifted by farmacybeauty recently. I love using this moisturizer at night because the cream is pretty thick. I'm not a huge fan of the smell but the I love the texture of the product. The packaging is beautiful and I love the wood cap. Everything about the product feels luxurious!

The Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer I received complimentary from Pharmacy has been exactly what my skin needed in the cooler months! It's super emollient and doesn't feel heavy on the skin. My skin feels happy and plump with each use! About the size of 2 peas is all I need for my face and neck.

This moisturizer is EVERYTHING!! It's sooo hydrating and such a radiance booster. It's become my go-to moisturizer! I love the silky smooth texture, it's very lightweight on my skin and doesn't feel heavy, my skin soaks it right up! It leaves my skin soft, smooth and so hydrated. This is a must have moisturizer especially in the winter months, it will keep your skin hydrated and plump! Gifted by Farmacy

This is probably my favorite moisturizer right now especially because the winter has been so dry. It literally feels like butter on your skin. At least it's so moisturized and Dewey. Highly recommend this will be purchasing again.

This creamy, rich ultra-hydrating ceramide moisturizer is proven to improve the look of fine lines and replenish dry, dull skin. This ultra hydrating cream has quickly become a favorite to add into my nightly routine. It blends beautifully into my skin, leaving it feeling moisturized and smooth.

Farmacy has always been one of my favorite skincare brands and their honey halo moisturizer is literally heaven sent during the winter!! I don't know what I would do without this - it got rid of all my dryness. Gifted by Farmacy beauty

The farmacy moisturizer is super hydrated. It feels very rich and nourishing. It is a great winter moisturizer or great for dry skin. My skin feels supple and hydrated in this cold winter. It comes with a cute little spatula too. Gifted by farmacy beauty.
